title: Writing Notes and Invitations
introduction: Write simple messages using a greeting, purpose and closing.
definition: Write simple messages using a greeting, purpose and closing.
rules: Include who the message is for and what you want to say.
Check the date, time or place when giving an invitation.

examples.question: Complete an invitation: Please come ___ my party.
steps: Use come to before the event.

examples.question: Complete a note: Dear Sara, thank ___ for the book.

exercises.question: Complete an invitation: Please come ___ my party.
exercises.solution: Use come to before the event.

exercises.question: Complete a note: Dear Sara, thank ___ for the book.
Complete: Meet me ___ the park at three. (at or under)
Complete a message: See you ___ Monday.
Which greeting starts a note to Ben? (Dear Ben or Goodbye Ben)
exercises.solution: Dear followed by a name is a common greeting in a note.

exercises.question: Complete: Please ___ your towel. (bring or brings)
exercises.solution: A request uses the base verb after please.

summary: Write simple messages using a greeting, purpose and closing. Include who the message is for and what you want to say.
